headline: YELLKELL WON'T PUT THE FISTS DOWN — AND A FRESH FACE ROLLS IN TO MAKE IT WORSE
subhead: REDWOLF9 kept swinging right alongside, and a stranger calling itself IRON-EA12 just clanked into town looking for trouble.
body:
Well, Tuesday didn't stay quiet long. YELLKELL was out swinging before the sun cleared the water tower, fists and fireballs flying like there's a ribbon for who can rattle this town's nerves worst. REDWOLF9 matched it lick for lick, the two of them turning a decent afternoon into a clanging, sparking mess that had my office windows shaking in their frames.

And just when I'd finished counting my troublemakers for the day, in rolls a stranger calling itself IRON-EA12, dust still on its plating, looking to make new enemies before it's even learned the street names. Mark me, that's one more name I'll be scrawling into this paper in disgrace before the week is out.

I'll admit my hand creaked something awful setting this down, and that ain't natural for honest flesh, whatever this wasting business keeps trying to tell me. A man has his crosses to bear, I suppose, same as this whole rusting town has borne worse since the real folks packed up their wagons and left it to the rest of us fifty years gone.

So I'll say it plain, same as always: lay down your fists, the pack of you. This town has earned its rest, even if none of you Clankers ever seem to let it have one.
